title: Employee record extensions · diversity, unions, re-verification, regulated declarations (M01 §3.11)
Employee declares a disability with consent
story: As an employee, I want to declare a disability only if I choose, with my consent, so that I get the benefits I am owed without everyone seeing it.
acceptance: Given the consent notice, when the employee declares yes with category, percentage and certificate, then it is saved as Special class with the consent record (YX-EMP-14)
Given consent is withdrawn, when the employee withdraws it, then the declaration is no longer used and the withdrawal is audited (YX-EMP-14)
Given a manager opens the employee's record, then no disability section is shown (YX-EMP-14)
Given payroll runs, then payroll sees only the ESI PwD ceiling flag, not the details (YX-EMP-14)

title: Diversity report hides small groups
story: As an HR admin, I want a diversity report that never reveals a person through a small count, so that we can report on inclusion safely.
acceptance: Given a report cell with fewer than 5 people, when the report is shown, then the count is suppressed (YX-EMP-14)
Given 5 or more people, then the aggregate count is shown (YX-EMP-14)
Given any export of the report, then the same suppression applies (YX-EMP-14)

title: HR-IR keeps the union register per establishment
story: As an HR-IR officer, I want to record each union, its office bearers and its recognition with dates, so that we know who we negotiate with.
acceptance: Given a legal entity or establishment, when HR-IR adds a union with registration no., office bearers and recognition basis and dates, then it is saved per establishment (YX-EMP-15)
Given recognition changes, then the old recognition keeps its dates and the new one starts on its date (YX-EMP-15)
Given a user without the HR-IR role, then the register is not visible (YX-EMP-15)

title: Dated union membership with check-off consent
story: As an HR-IR officer, I want to record an employee's union membership with dates and check-off consent, so that dues are deducted only with consent.
acceptance: Given an employee joins a union from a date, then the membership is dated and Confidential (HR-IR and payroll for dues only) (YX-EMP-15)
Given check-off consent is given, then payroll deducts dues; without it, no deduction (YX-EMP-15)
Given a manager views the record, then membership is never shown (YX-EMP-15)

title: Company rule opens a re-verification cycle with fresh consent
story: As an HR admin, I want re-verification to start only from a company rule and only after fresh consent, so that we meet client and role requirements lawfully.
acceptance: Given a rule (every N years, move into a sensitive role, or a client mandate), when it triggers, then a re-verification cycle opens for the employee (YX-EMP-16)
Given the cycle is open, then nothing is sent to the BGV partner until the employee gives fresh consent (YX-EMP-16)
Given no company rule, then no re-verification ever runs (YX-EMP-16)

title: Re-verification results open an HR review
story: As an HR admin, I want results kept confidential and reviewed by a person, so that no one is affected by an automatic decision.
acceptance: Given results arrive, then they are Confidential and adverse findings are Special (YX-EMP-16)
Given an adverse finding, then an HR review task opens and no automatic action is taken (YX-EMP-16)
Given a manager, then results are never shown (YX-EMP-16)

title: Designated roles file fit-and-proper / KMP declarations
story: As a compliance officer in a bank or NBFC, I want designated roles to file fit-and-proper declarations yearly and on change, so that we meet RBI / SEBI / IRDAI directions.
acceptance: Given the BFSI pack is on, when a person holds a designated role, then a declaration is due yearly and on change (YX-EMP-17)
Given the due date passes, then reminders and escalation follow the company calendar (YX-EMP-17)
Given the pack is off, then no declaration is asked for (YX-EMP-17)

title: Every employee attests the code of conduct yearly
story: As a compliance officer, I want every employee to attest the current code of conduct each year by OTP, so that we have proof of acceptance.
acceptance: Given the pack is on, when the year starts, then each employee gets the current code-of-conduct version to attest by OTP (YX-EMP-17, YX-POL-02)
Given a new version is published, then the attestation is for that version (YX-EMP-17)
Given an employee has not attested by the due date, then escalation follows the company calendar (YX-EMP-17)

title: Insider-trading disclosures and trade pre-clearance
story: As a designated person, I want to file my holdings and ask pre-clearance before a big trade, so that I follow SEBI insider-trading rules.
acceptance: Given a person is designated, then holdings and relatives disclosures are due on designation and yearly (YX-EMP-18)
Given a trade above the company threshold, then pre-clearance is required (YX-EMP-18)
Given the trading window is closed, then a pre-clearance request is refused (YX-EMP-18)
Given an approved pre-clearance is not used within the company window, then it expires (YX-EMP-18)
